previewNote: In-memory only; refresh or switching language can clear changes. No database writes. AI and maps are demonstrations.
intro: A place for your plans, your people, and the decisions in between.
emptyBody: Create a draft to explore the workspace, or open the Tokyo example.
noResultsBody: Try a different name or destination.
name: Trip name
createIntro: Start with the essentials. You can add activities and your travel preferences next.
dateHint: Preview supports trips of 1–60 days. Dates use the trip timezone.
invalidDates: Choose a valid range of 1–60 days.
invalidBudget: Enter a non-negative amount with up to 2 decimal places.
invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, such as Asia/Tokyo.
created: Local draft created. Not saved to Supabase.
saved: Changes saved in this tab only.
noActivitiesBody: Add the first activity for this day.
mapHint: Select an activity to see it in the plan. Real routes and travel times will come from the map provider later.
noCoordinates: This activity has no map coordinates yet.
aiIntro: Everyone wants a different kind of perfect. Let’s find the overlap.
aiExample: Charlie wants less walking, but Shibuya Sky matters. A café break could make room for both.
chatNote: Demo only: messages are not sent to other members or an AI service.
proposalReason: Keep Shibuya Sky, replace the shopping detour with a café break, and move the afternoon later.
voteRule: Demo rule: 4/4 approvals. This is not the final product voting policy.
reasonHint: Tell the group what matters. Your note stays in this tab.
noProposalsBody: An AI integration will create proposals here. Explore the example to try the decision flow.
budgetIntro: See the trade-offs before you make the decision. This is forecasting, not expense splitting.
estimateNote: Amounts are activity estimates, not paid expenses. Demo forecast includes illustrative future costs.
memberIntro: A good group trip leaves room for differences.
inviteNote: Invitations and shared membership will be connected after the data model is confirmed.
preferenceIntro: Preferences belong to a trip: your budget and pace may change from one journey to the next.
chooseTrip: Choose a trip to set your preferences.
accountIntro: Your sign-in is real. The workspace data is still a local UI prototype.
notFound: This draft isn’t in this tab.
notFoundBody: Drafts are in memory only. Refreshing the page clears them; no cloud save has occurred.
warning: Sample alert: rain may affect outdoor plans.
evidence: Illustrative evidence: all four members are interested; indoor option. Opening times, prices and availability are not verified.
snapshot: A shared plan, not a booking list.
activityAdded: Activity added to this local draft.
invalidDuration: Enter a duration from 1 to 1440 minutes.
currencyHint: All activity estimates use the trip’s currency.
proposalStale: The sample itinerary was edited. Reset the demo before trying the preset proposal.
